outfit: a white short-sleeve medical-style scrub top worn as streetwear with a black long-sleeve tee underneath, a red cross pin, a thin gold chain

shamz.s1_hurt: He clutches his side, wincing, looking at the camera, one hand raised in a 'hold on' gesture. Background: a Florida city street at night after a shootout, a damaged car, broken glass, police lights far away, no readable signs.
shamz.s2_drink: He tilts his head back drinking from a small plain green energy can with no label, eyes on the camera. Background: a quiet small-town Florida kitchen at night, warm light, a fridge with plain doors, absolutely no signs and no letters.
shamz.s3_flex: He flexes one arm with a proud grin at the camera. Background: an open-air Florida beach gym at sunset, weights, palm trees.

scenes.b_cans: Small plain green energy-drink cans with no labels and no logos stacked on a shop shelf, a glowing fridge, a Florida convenience store at night.
scenes.b_food: A Cuban sandwich, fries and a cold drink with no logos on a street-food counter in a Florida city at night, string lights, palm trees.
scenes.b_bed: A cosy small safehouse bedroom at night, an unmade bed, warm lamp, a fan turning, a window with palm shadows.
